pms.thesis: The book stays flat through Nov 25. Short AUDCAD, paying the US two-year at 4.63, receiving the US ten-year at 4.92, receiving March 2027 SOFR at 4.42, and buying USDNOK do not show an expected edge above official SOFR at 3.91 percent on shocked risk capital. December 2026 SOFR at 4.235 and March 2027 at 4.42 already set the funding path a new line has to beat. With the VIX at 28.44, the plausible adverse move dominates two-day carry.
